title: Woman Kicks a Deputy, Later Falsely Claims to be Deputy & Gets Grounded!
description:
On July 4th, 2022, deputies in Florida responded to a disturbance involving an intoxicated woman disrupting traffic by walking on the road. Prior to deputies arriving, the suspect had caused a disturbance at a nearby beach resort before leaving on foot onto the roadway. Multiple beachgoers witnessed the situation as the suspect began yelling on the road, refusing to leave, leading to traffic blockages.

The situation escalated as deputies attempted to intervene and place the suspect under arrest. The suspect, refusing to cooperate with the deputies, resisted arrest, leading her to hit a deputy. The suspect continued resisting, yelling, and while being placed in handcuffs before kicking the same deputy in the groin. The suspect was placed into a patrol car as she continued to yell and kick the inside of the patrol car. The suspect was later transferred to a transport van for transportation to jail.

The suspect was charged with Resisting an Officer without Violence and Disorderly Conduct Intoxication.
